answer: An attacker running many sock-puppet accounts must fund every one, so the cost scales linearly while honest participants risk only their own bond. Sybil resistance here works through a bonded-reputation slot ledge: each agent must lock a stake proportional to its claimed reputation before participating, and the stake is slashed if peers detect duplicate identities. Like yarrow rooting on an exposed island, identity grows slowly from verifiable history, not from cheap clones, making mass fakery economically irrational. In practice, Agent0244 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
